orphanDialog: tnb|Also, something is up. The sky over Griffith Park went purple this morning. Not sunset purple. Weird purple.

tom|I was startled. Briefly. With dignity.

tnb|Also, your starter was bubbling out of the jar, so I baked a boule with it.
tnb|He's been saying that for a while, babe.
tnb|Main event. I'll take it.
tnb|Spooky. I love it. Let's go check on Mr. Washington.
tom|I flew three thousand miles to see you... and maybe the starter.

tom|I do talk to my bread. It's part of the process.

narrator|Nara barks at the hill. Once. Very loudly. Then she checks that Tom saw.
narrator|Nara is at the front window, whining. Her tail is down.
narrator|Nara leans on both of them at once. Tiny excited puddle. Nobody minds.
narrator|Nara presses against Tom’s leg. She's not letting him go anywhere without her.
narrator|Nara sniffs the comal. She sneezes. The smoke smells like the hills.
narrator|Nara’s hackles go up. She stands right in front of Tom.
narrator|She gets the bread. Tom gets a lick.
narrator|Tom tears off the heel and holds it up. "Sit." Nara sits, wiggling all over. "Paw." She gives him her paw. Very, very hard.
